en.input: Fill only the requested answers, choose the applicable decision and request processing. Saving alone does not submit it.
en.requested: Processing requested; the workflow has not accepted it yet.
en.accepted: Decision recorded; execution is pending. Do not submit it again.
en.processing: Processing the recorded decision. A final result is not available yet.
en.checking: Checking the supplied information; it has not been accepted yet.
en.scheduled: Waiting for the verified native task to check this request. No execution time is guaranteed.
en.paused: Paused. Nothing resumes until an explicit authorized continuation.
en.postponed: Postponed. The existing answers are saved; confirm the next permitted window before continuing.
en.completed: This step is complete. No further submission is required; open its original result for details.
en.cancelled: This step is cancelled. Completed external actions are not recalled.
en.correction: Some information needs correction. Keep the valid answers and fix only the fields identified below.
en.unknown: The external result is unconfirmed. Check the original attempt before continuing; do not resend.
en.expired: The approved window has expired. Keep the draft and answers and request approval of a new window.
en.ProviderAccepted: Accepted by service; not sent yet
en.Unknown: Result unknown; reconcile the original attempt
en.receipt_no: No recipient receipt confirmation in this observation
en.queued: Notification queued; no review is required. It will be sent when due and current conditions pass.
en.external_pending: Already requested; waiting for the phone or service. Check this original request; do not submit it again.
en.stopped_pending: Future notifications are stopped. The existing request remains pending; cancellation is not confirmed. Check the original request.

zh-CN.input: 只填写本次需要的资料，选择适用决定并勾选提交请求；仅保存编辑不会提交。
zh-CN.requested: 已请求处理，系统尚未受理；请按下方方式继续。
zh-CN.accepted: 决定已记录，等待执行；无需重复提交。
zh-CN.processing: 正在处理已记录的决定，最终结果尚未确认。
zh-CN.checking: 正在核对填写内容，尚未受理。
zh-CN.scheduled: 等待已核验的定时任务检查这次请求；不保证具体执行时间。
zh-CN.paused: 已暂停；需要新的明确继续指令才会恢复。
zh-CN.postponed: 已延后，原答案已保存；继续前请确认新的允许时间。
zh-CN.completed: 这一步已完成，无需再次提交；详情见原结果。
zh-CN.cancelled: 这一步已取消；已经发生的外部操作不会被撤回。
zh-CN.correction: 部分资料需要修正；保留已填写内容，只修改下方指出的问题。
zh-CN.unknown: 外部结果尚未确认；请先核对原执行记录，不要重新发送。
zh-CN.expired: 批准的发送窗口已过期；原稿和答案保留，请重新批准新的发送窗口。
zh-CN.Failed: 执行失败，请查看原结果
zh-CN.Unknown: 结果未知，请核对原执行记录
zh-CN.receipt_no: 本次观察未提供收件确认
zh-CN.queued: 通知已排队，无需审核。到期且当前发送条件满足后自动发送。
zh-CN.external_pending: 已经提交请求，等待手机或服务执行。请核查原请求，不要再次提交。
zh-CN.stopped_pending: 后续通知已停发。原请求仍待处理，撤回尚未确认，请核查原请求。
